title: Spotlight suggested Research marks
description: data/research-suggestions.json: written by the investigator in AMENDMENT mode before the Research page opens. One suggested mark and a one-line reason for every clue (pursue or dismiss) and every direction (keep or drop), plus any direction it suggests adding. The page shows them as suggestions; only the member's marks (data/research-review.json) count. `inputs` names the hashes of the leads, clues and triage the suggestions were written for; when any of them changes, the suggestions are written again before the page opens.

clues.description: One entry per clue in data/clues.json.

directions.description: One entry per direction of the approved investigation_plan (keep or drop), and one per direction the investigator suggests adding (add, with its text and questions).

direction.description: For add: the new direction's text.

questions.description: For add: the questions it answers.
